item.tib: bla ma dgongs 'dus rgya mtsho'i mchod sgrub rin chen gter gyi phreng ba'i rgyud las las byang rnam rgyal khang bzang
item.note: this includes 3 folios of another text; two of them were inserted after folio 2, and the other one was inserted after folio 6, but now they have been relocated at the end of the text.
